entities.summary: James Armstrong Mackay was an American politician and attorney from Georgia. Mackay was first elected to the United States House of Representatives in 1964, representing the 4th district as a Democrat. He served a single term, losing his re-election bid in 1966. He died on July 2, 2004, in Chattanooga, Tennessee.
